subject: Researchers are building a healthspan field rooted in early life
script: From Agewell Brief: Researchers are building a healthspan field rooted in early life. Scientists are developing a new field to help us stay healthier longer, with roots in early life. Lifespans are increasing in many countries, but healthspan may lag. Longevity medicine aims to extend healthy years, not just life. New approaches may start before we're born, shaping future health. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
